summary: Tested Inventory MongoDB caching (instant load + IST badge) and Admin MSL/Lead Time numeric sort. Both features working correctly. GET /api/inventory returns cached 3177 items with updated_at populated; page renders stat cards + table in <1s. IST badge shows 'Last Updated: 07 Aug 2026, 06:02 pm IST' correctly next to title. Of first 50 visible rows, 38 now show populated Unit Cost/Total Value (previously mostly '-'), confirming the product_uuid backfill fix works. Admin MSL and Lead Time (Days) headers sort numerically asc/desc with correct null-handling (nulls sorted as -Infinity) and sort icon toggling. Existing Product ID/Category sort and Inventory search/filter/expand/pagination all regression-free. BOM Explorer and Purchasing Plan pages load fine (smoke test) - no breakage from shared sap_soap_client.py/bom_cache_service.py changes.

minor.issue: Cached response takes 3-8s (not literally instant) due to ~1.27MB JSON payload (3177 items) over the preview proxy - still vastly better than the multi-minute live SAP pull it replaces, but worth noting if 'instant' is a strict requirement. Could consider pagination/compression server-side if this becomes an issue at larger scale.

critical_code_review_comments: inventory_service.py and server.py changes are clean, well-documented, and match the described design (zero extra SAP calls for uuid backfill, graceful degradation on Standard Costs failure).

AdminPage.js numeric sort comparator correctly branches for msl/lead_time_days fields using ?? -Infinity, verified with real data (SPC5WM=500, SPC22WM=250, others null) - null items correctly grouped below (desc) or above (asc) valued items.
No code changes made during this test session; all functionality verified as-is.
seed_data_creation: None - used pre-existing inventory_cache (3177 items) and admin components (SPC* items) data as described in review request
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inventory cache, IST badge, and Admin MSL/Lead Time sort all verified working via API curl checks and Playwright UI tests. Did not test the live-pull Refresh button path end-to-end (per review request, this can take 2-5min and intermittently fail on the SAP tenant - not required since cache-read path was the main focus and is confirmed working). Did not re-test MSL/Lead Time SAP write-back, bulk Excel import/export, or Admin pagination (covered by iteration_24-28, no regressions expected/observed).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found in this session's changes
